extracted.name: Perfectly Crispy Grilled Cheese
extracted.description: Learn how to make a crispy grilled cheese sandwich with bread, cheese, and one tablespoon of mayonnaise, the secret ingredient, instead of butter!
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon Hellmann's® or Best Foods® Real Mayonnaise
instruction_lines: Spread one bread slice with mayonnaise. Place bread, mayonnaise-side down, onto a hot skillet. Add cheese slices. Spread the remaining bread slice with mayonnaise and place on top of the cheese with the mayonnaise facing up.
Cook until lightly browned on one side. Flip over and cook until cheese is melted.
